stem_en:
Which of the following statements are NOT correct?
Choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

statements.label: A
statements.text: Hydrogen is used to reduce heavy metal oxides to metals.

statements.label: B
statements.text: Heavy water is used to study reaction mechanism.

statements.label: C
statements.text: Hydrogen is used to make saturated fats from oils.

statements.label: D
statements.text: The H-H bond dissociation enthalpy is lowest as compared to a single bond between two atoms of any element.

statements.label: E
statements.text: Hydrogen reduces oxides of metals that are more active than iron.
